entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is AssistBot. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago and it’s just not working out for me. I want my money back.

Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah, and I can certainly assist you with your VeloBand Pulse return. I understand your frustration when a product doesn't meet your expectations. Can you please provide me with your order number?

Ugh, finally! It's #VF78923. Seriously, this thing is a piece of junk! It keeps losing connection and the heart rate monitor is all over the place. I need to know where I can send it back so I get my money back.

Thank you, I have located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 10th. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. So, returning your VeloBand Pulse should be no problem at all.

Ninety days? Are you sure? I thought it was shorter than that! Look, I’m not trying to scam anyone. I just want to return the thing! It’s been, like, 15 days. I just saw on a different website that other smart watch companies only gave 10 days and was worried. Where do I send it?

Yes, I am certain. Our return policy is 90 days from the date of purchase for most of our products. It looks like I did make an error previously. Some accessories have shorter return windows, but for the VeloBand Pulse, you are well within the timeframe. I can process this return for you right away. You don't need to worry about the 10 days or anything like that. I will email you a prepaid shipping label to return the VeloBand Pulse. Once we receive the device, we will process your refund. May I have your email address to confirm?
Finally! My email is frustratedcustomer@email.com. Just send the label already. This has been way more complicated than it should be. You guys need to fix this process.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for any inconvenience. The email with the prepaid shipping label is on its way to frustratedcustomer@email.com. Please be sure to package the VeloBand Pulse securely to prevent any damage during transit. As an apology for the initial error, I am also adding a 10% discount code to your account for your next purchase. It will be valid for 90 days. Our manager also wants to ensure you are happy with this resolution.
Okay, a discount is nice. Thanks. Is there anything else I need to do?

No, that's all. Just print the label, pack up the VeloBand Pulse, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. You'll receive an email confirmation once we've received the returned item and processed your refund. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you. I appreciate you sorting this out, and the discount is great.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
